title: Upload or Load Holdings
description: Accepts XLSX, XLS, or CSV snapshots with market value, book cost, gain/loss, identifiers, asset type, and currency.

title: Normalize Portfolio Data
description: Maps common column aliases, standardizes asset types, and derives missing gain/loss fields where possible.

title: Calculate Snapshot Metrics
description: Computes market value, book cost, gain/loss, allocation, concentration, key drivers, winners, losers, and risk flags.

title: Pull Public Research
description: Reads public webpages and RSS feeds for macro, monetary policy, market news, industry, and fund context.

title: Generate Commentary
description: Builds metric-aware institutional or retail commentary using deterministic fallback and optional local Ollama.

title: Run Quality Checks
description: Checks for required sections, vague language, missing metric references, and generic AI-style phrasing.

title: Export Report
description: Produces client-ready Markdown and optional PDF output from the local Python app.
